master.definition_en: A malignant germ cell tumor arising from the ovary. Morphologically, it is identical to seminoma and consists of a monotonous population of germ cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and uniform nuclei. The stroma invariably contains chronic inflammatory cells, mostly T-lymphocytes. It responds to chemotherapy or radiotherapy and the prognosis relates to the tumor stage.

master.definition_en: Myelofibrosis with myeloid metaplasia is a myeloproliferative disease with annual incidence of approximately 1 case per 100,000 individuals and age at diagnosis around 60 (an increased prevalence is noted in Ashkenazi Jews). Clinical manifestations depend on the type of blood cell affected and may include anemia, pallor, splenomegaly, hypermetabolic state, petechiae, ecchymosis, bleeding, lymphadenopathy, hepatomegaly, portal hypertension.

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 慢性骨髓增殖性肿瘤(MPN)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 骨髓造血微环境被纤维瘢痕组织逐步替代，引发髓外造血（巨脾、肝脏肿大）、严重贫血及消耗性体质症状；低危患者中位生存期可达10–15年以上，而高危组中位生存仅1.5–3年；并发门静脉高压食管胃底静脉曲张大出血、致命性血栓栓塞或向急性白血病转化时可迅速致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 异基因造血干细胞移植是唯一根治手段，适用于年轻中高危患者；绝大多数患者通过口服JAK抑制剂（芦可替尼/泽布替尼/莫美洛替尼等）可显著缩小巨脾、消除盗汗乏力等症状并延长生存，实现长期带病稳控。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未单列PMF；全球年发病率约5–15/百万，约55%–60%携带JAK2 V617F突变、25%–30%携带CALR突变、5%–10%携带MPL突变

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡统计；国内PMF发病年龄较欧美略年轻（中位约55–60岁），高危组主要死因为感染、出血及白血病转化
annual_deaths_china.source: 《原发性骨髓纤维化诊断与治疗中国指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 年发病率约0.5–1.5/10万，属BCR-ABL阴性经典骨髓增殖性肿瘤(MPN)中预后最差的一型（Orphanet ORPHA:824）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 推算全国现患患者数万例，约85%–90%可检出JAK2/CALR/MPL三大驱动基因之一

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 巨脾合并门静脉高压致食管胃底静脉曲张破裂大出血：立即禁食、静脉生长抑素/特利加压素降门脉压、输血扩容并急诊内镜套扎止血; 2) 巨脾自发梗死或破裂出血（突发左上腹剧痛休克）：绝对卧床并急诊介入脾动脉部分栓塞或外科评估; 3) 停用芦可替尼切忌骤停，否则可诱发致命性‘JAK抑制剂撤药综合征’（高热、休克、脾脏反跳性肿大），必须逐步减量或激素桥接。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 兼顾贫血的JAK/ACVR1抑制剂莫美洛替尼(FDA批准)与国产吉卡昔尼(NMPA批准)打破传统芦可替尼加重贫血的瓶颈; 2) 联合方案成为3期焦点：BET抑制剂Pelabresib联合芦可替尼(MANIFEST-2 3期)显著提高脾脏缩小率并部分逆转骨髓纤维化，BCL-XL/BCL-2抑制剂Navitoclax及端粒酶抑制剂Imetelstat(IMpactMF 3期以OS为终点)正验证生存延长获益; 3) 针对CALR外显子9突变的新型双特异性抗体(INCA033989)及疫苗进入早期临床，有望实现突变克隆靶向清除。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 现有JAK抑制剂主要控制症状与缩脾，难以真正逆转骨髓纤维化或阻止克隆演进向白血病转化; 2) 合并重度血小板减少(<50×10^9/L)的患者难以足量使用JAK抑制剂; 3) 芦可替尼耐药或失效后中位生存仅约1年，亟需非JAK靶点新药。

master.definition_en: Bjrnstad syndrome is characterized by congenital sensorineural hearing loss and pili torti. Less than fifty cases have been reported so far. The hearing loss usually becomes evident very early in life, often in the first year. Pili torti, a condition in which the hair shaft is flattened and twisted, makes the hair very brittle and patients develop hair loss in the first two years of life. Bjrnstad syndrome is transmitted as an autosomal recessive condition. It is caused by mutations in the BCS1L gene. Mutations in this gene also cause GRACILE syndrome.
synonyms_en: deafness and pili torti, Bjornstad type
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 28 is a pure form of hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by a childhood or adolescent onset of slowly progressive, pure crural muscle spastic paraparesis which manifests with mild lower limb weakness, gait difficulties, extensor plantar responses, and hyperreflexia of lower extremities. master.name_en: epidermolysis bullosa simplex 6, generalized, with scarring and hair loss
master.definition_en: A rare, inherited, epidermolysis bullosa characterized by aplasia cutis congenita on the extremities, leaving behind hypopigmentation and atrophy in a whirled pattern. Generalized blistering persists during childhood and heals with cutaneous and follicular atrophy, linear and stellate scars, and hypopigmentation. Skin fragility decreases with adulthood. Adult patients exhibit dyspigmentation and atrophy of the skin, scars, follicular atrophoderma, sparse body hair, progressive diffuse alopecia of the scalp, diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma, and nail changes. Dilative cardiomyopathy with heart failure complicates the disease course in young adulthood or later and may have lethal outcome. Ultra-structurally, intraepidermal splitting appears at the level of the basal keratinocytes, above the hemidesmosomes.

aliases_zh: 遗传性视网膜色素变性
curated.category: 罕见遗传性致盲性视网膜疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 由近百种不同基因突变引起视网膜光感受器（视杆与视锥细胞）进行性凋亡，属最常见的遗传性致盲眼病（一般不影响寿命，除非合并Usher综合征耳聋或全身代谢综合征）；典型表现为童年/青少年期夜盲、视野从周边向中心呈“管状”缩小，最终在中老年期进展为重度低视力甚至全盲。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 过去完全无药可治，如今携带双等位基因RPE65突变的患者（约占1%–2%）已有全球首个获批的眼科AAV2基因替代疗法Voretigene neparvovec（Luxturna）实现视力功能改善；对于占98%以上的其他基因型，当前仍以低视力助视器、并发白内障手术及参加前沿光遗传学/基因疗法临床试验为主。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet未单列直接死亡率，核心危害为不可逆盲

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球患病率约1/3,000–1/5,000（全球患者约150万–200万例，Orphanet ORPHA:791）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国北京眼病研究等估算患病率约1/1,000–1/3,000，全国患者估计超过100万例，已纳入国家罕见病目录

standard_drugs.drug_class: AAV2介导的RPE65基因替代疗法（一次性视网膜下腔注射）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 仅适用于经基因检测确认双等位基因RPE65突变且尚存足够存活视网膜细胞的患者（中国内地尚未正式获批，部分患者关注海外或先行区途径）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 海外单眼定价约42.5万美元（双眼约合人民币600万元左右）

standard_drugs.name_zh: 叶黄素 / 玉米黄质（辅助支持）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 日常辅助抗氧化支持（避坑提示：过去曾流行大剂量维生素A棕榈酸酯，近年循证再评估发现其疗效存疑且有肝毒/骨松风险，不再常规盲目大剂量推荐）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 常见膳食营养剂参考价

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系遗传排查与精准基因分型（重中之重）：RP遗传方式涵盖常染色体显性（30%–40%）、常染色体隐性（50%–60%）及X连锁（RPGR等，5%–15%），必须行遗传性视网膜疾病（IRD）全外显子基因检测明确致病基因——既能筛选是否可入组基因治疗临床试验，也能在再生育时通过PGT-M或产前诊断阻断家族盲症遗传
及时处理并发性白内障（超声乳化+人工晶体植入常能明显改善残余中心视力）及黄斑囊样水肿
户外佩戴滤过短波蓝光/紫外线的深色防眩光眼镜，尽早学习盲文、手机读屏软件及定向行走训练
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 常规眼科随访、基因检测（一次性约3,000–5,000元）及助视器年费约2,000–6,000元人民币（不含海外天价RPE65基因疗法）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 针对RPE65的Luxturna已证实基因疗法可持久改善光敏感度；针对X连锁RP（RPGR基因）与PDE6A/6B的AAV基因治疗正处于3期（如Botaretigene sparoparvovec等）推进；2) 鉴于RP致病基因多达近百种，中国在“不依赖具体突变基因的通用型光遗传学疗法”走在全球前列——如中眸医疗ZM-02（MOON试验）、健安思GA001（cOpn5）及化学诱导光感受器细胞移植（NouvSight001）正使晚期盲人患者重获光感与轮廓分辨。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 超过98%的RP患者不属于RPE65型，亟待基因无关型（光遗传学/细胞移植/视网膜假体）及常见RPGR/USH2A/RHO基因疗法获批；2) Luxturna海外高达600万元人民币的费用完全超出普通家庭承受力；3) 基层眼科缺乏ERG与免费/普惠基因检测通道，错失临床试验入组黄金期。

master.definition_en: A serious, life threatening rare neurologic disease characterized by a sudden rupture of an intracranial aneurysm into the subarachnoid space. It usually presents with a sudden, severe, excruciating headache accompanied by nausea, vomiting and syncope. Other features may include focal neurological signs, third and sixth nerve palsies, seizures and cardiac failure. Early complications include rebleeding, hydrocephalus, and seizures.

master.definition_en: A rare pure hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by spastic paraparesis and normal neuroimaging (no leukodystrophy or calcification in the brain). It is a slowly progressing disease in which patients present with varying degrees of toe-walking, frequent falls and a spastic gait, as well as increased tone or obvious spastic paralysis, weakness, and hyperreflexia of the lower limbs. Additional clinical features may include gross hematuria, fibrillation and atrophy of the tongue muscles, and upper limb involvement such as bilateral upper extremity weakness, hypotonia, and atrophy of the interosseous and thenar muscles in the hands. Chilblain lesions and intellectual disability are absent.
